mapper.select: SELECT * FROM user u JOIN photo p ON u.user_no = p.related_entity_id WHERE u.user_no IN (SELECT followee_no from follow where follower_no = #{userNo} ) AND p.related_type = 'USER' # 유저가 팔로우 하고 있는 유저 리스트

SELECT u.user_no, u.user_id, u.user_name, u.user_intro, p.photo_no, p.photo_url, CASE WHEN u.user_no IN (SELECT followee_no FROM follow WHERE follower_no = #{userNo}) THEN true ELSE false END AS is_followed FROM user u JOIN photo p ON u.user_no = p.related_entity_id WHERE u.user_no IN (SELECT follower_no FROM follow WHERE followee_no = #{userNo}) AND p.related_type = 'USER'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM follow WHERE follower_no = #{followerNo} AND followee_no = #{followeeNo};
